# KaTeX vendored assets

This directory contains a minimal subset of [KaTeX](https://katex.org/) 0.16.11:

- `katex.min.css`
- `katex.min.js`
- `contrib/auto-render.min.js`
- `fonts/`

It is vendored so the reader works offline and on GitHub Pages without a CDN.
KaTeX is MIT-licensed; see `LICENSE` in this directory.
